note: Rewritten from Ruelle (1970), who restored the species to Macrotermes falciger (from Amplitermes goliath) and placed Termes goliath, T. michelli, T. swaziae, Macrotermes usutu and Tumulitermes kibonotensis in synonymy; measurements in mm (means in parentheses) are printed as in the original, where hyphens stand for decimal points; figures and distribution records omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate with head dark chestnut-brown and paler around the fontanelle, pronotum darker than head with a T-shaped yellow mark and a yellow spot near each antero-lateral corner, wings light smoky; major soldier with rectangular head in dorsal view and very stout mandibles; minor soldier with trapezoidal head and a wart-like fontanelle; major worker with dark chestnut-brown head.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier: head capsule dark chestnut-brown, mandibles black throughout; antennal segments darker than the head; pronotum sometimes darker than the head, meso- and metanotum and abdominal tergites the same colour as the pronotum, sternites lighter; legs yellow-brown, tarsi not darker than tibiae. Head rectangular in dorsal view without a distinctive shape, usually larger and wider than in subhyalinus; in profile with numerous setae on the postmentum, frontal area moderately depressed and bearing a median, elongate, triangular, transversely wrinkled mound. Mandibles very stout, left broader and more incurved than right, the latter hooked only at the tip. Antennae 17-jointed, third segment twice as long as the second, fourth intermediate; pilosity of head capsule and postmentum conspicuous; hyaline tip of labrum with sides straight or even concave. Thoracic nota very large and strongly chitinized; pronotum with broadly rounded lateral lobes and the widest, mesonotum in most cases wider than metanotum, hind margin of metanotum often concave. Measurements (142 specimens from 64 localities, mm): head length 5.20–7.43 (mean 6.64), width 4.00–6.14 (5.29), depth including gula 2.65–3.84 (3.28), gula length 4.05–4.93 (4.45), minimum gula width 0.94–1.26 (1.09), left mandible 2.85–4.01 (3.57), hind tibia 3.10–5.16 (4.18), pronotum length 1.70–2.61 (2.21).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Major worker with head dark chestnut-brown and a rounded posterior margin; head width (138 specimens from 36 localities) 2.64–3.50 mm, mean 2.99 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark chestnut-brown, lighter around the fontanelle; postclypeus the same colour as or slightly lighter than the head. Pronotum darker than the head with a T-shaped yellowish mark in the middle and a yellow spot near each antero-lateral corner; tibiae darker than femora; abdominal tergites darker than sternites; wings light smoky. Head capsule in plan view not distinctive, setae sparse; fontanellar area depressed, the depression horseshoe- or U-shaped in dorsal view; fontanelle conspicuous, surrounded by short setae, preceded by a distinct median carina. Eyes proportionately small and not very prominent; ocelli small and oval, about half their major diameter from the eye; postclypeus relatively narrow but somewhat inflated; antennae 19-jointed, third segment equal to fourth plus fifth. Pronotum wider than the head across the eyes and long, front margin shallowly emarginate, posterior flatly incurvate, antero-lateral corners rounded; setae more numerous than on the head. Hind tibia long, usually well beyond 5.0 mm. Measurements (42 specimens from 19 localities, mm): head width across eyes 3.76–4.27 (mean 3.97), eye major diameter 1.11–1.34, ocellus major diameter 0.37–0.48 (0.41), minor diameter 0.27–0.38 (0.32), ocellus-eye distance 0.25–0.45 (0.32), pronotum length 1.97–2.27 (2.12), width 3.61–4.41 (4.01), hind tibia 4.99–5.97 (5.58), forewing length 33.00–43.00 (38.30), width 8.00–10.20 (9.10).

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Minor soldier: head smoky brown, paler beneath; mandibles black with a dark sepia-brown base; antennal segments distinctly darker than the head capsule; thoracic nota and abdominal tergites the same colour as the antennae. Head trapezoidal in dorsal view with convex sides; fontanelle slightly protruding, wart-like; mandibles more slender than in the major soldier, left evenly incurved, right hooked, tips at 90° or more inwards; hind tibia usually longer than head width; sides of thoracic tergites rounded, mesonotum nearly as wide as metanotum. Measurements (176 specimens from 65 localities, mm): head length 3.04–4.77 (mean 3.79), width 2.59–3.87 (3.11), depth 1.64–2.47 (2.03), gula length 1.91–3.15 (2.40), maximum gula width 0.84–1.25 (0.93), left mandible 2.23–3.19 (2.65), hind tibia 2.57–3.87 (3.21), pronotum length 1.20–2.10 (1.45), width 2.15–3.42 (2.61).
